Name: Hojoo's Toddlers
Author: HojooHojoo
Description:
This mod overrides the toddler and baby image files without needing to replace the XNB.

~INSTALLATION~
1. If you haven't already, install the latest versions of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Download this mod (it'll download as a .zip file).
3. Extract the .zip into your "Mods" folder (found in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods).
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

~UNINSTALLATION~
1. Delete the folder from your "Mods" folder.
